subject: SEND - New notification from ${notification.sender.paDenomination} - ${notification.iun}
body1: <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>Your business has received a notification from ${notification.sender.paDenomination} with IUN Code ${notification.iun} on SEND - Servizio Notifiche Digitali.
body2: <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>The business has up to 120 days from the date of finalization of the notification to access the documents. The deadline for payment, if applicable, and for any appeals is indicated in the documents.
body3: A notification is a legally binding communication consisting of a notification of receipt and one or more documents.
perfection: If you access the communication within 5 days from the sending of this email, you will avoid a registered mail and any related costs.
read_more: SEND is a tool that makes sending notifications by the Public Administration safer, more efficient and cheaper. Find out more
footer: You are receiving this communication because you have entered <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>your email address<#else>the company email address among the courtesy notifications of SEND. To modify your contact details or add others, go to your contact details.
